capabilities: IPTW/IPCW, AIPW, g-formula, TMLE and transportability tools
limitation: Observed last push May 2023; qualify dependency compatibility and exact longitudinal method scope
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Method-specific treatment/outcome/covariate data and explicitly selected weighting, g-computation, targeting or transport model.
scientific_qualification.output: A specified point/longitudinal/transport estimand with that method's diagnostics.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Selected method's exchangeability, positivity, missingness and transport conditions.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Qualify individual classes before adapter implementation. The README documents monotone missingness for IPMW and single-time-point SNMM g-estimation; do not advertise general longitudinal SNMM fitting from the umbrella name.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare a chosen AIPW/g-computation class with an exact finite oracle, reject a nonmonotone pattern on a monotone-only path and distinguish point-treatment from longitudinal inputs.

evidence.finding: Specific g-method/transport features, monotone IPMW and single-time SNMM scope.
